summary: Overview section of the Ledger Service Design. States the service records every transfer between accounts, then repeats a fixed set of operational assertions many times with no supporting detail: a three-phase zero-downtime migration, structured request-id logging, unit test coverage, schema review for index impact, a 200 ms p95 read latency target, health/readiness endpoints, low-priority backfills, single YAML config, alert routing, 90-day secret rotation, and per-region dashboards.

claims.text: The Ledger service records every transfer between accounts.
The migration ran in three phases over two weekends without downtime.
Read latency target is under 200 ms at the 95th percentile.
Unit tests cover the parser, the validator, and the posting logic.
Alerts route to the payments channel and page after five minutes.
Secrets rotate every ninety days through the platform vault.

risks.note: 200 ms p95 read target stated with no measurement or source.
Three phases over two weekends without downtime; no migration record cited.
Unit test coverage claimed with no test list or coverage data.
Section repeats the same sentences many times; reads as filler rather than design content.

least_confident: Whether the heavy repetition hides a subtle variant of any sentence; I found none, but every assertion lacks evidence.
